description:
List bounties posted by a BTC address. Defaults to the current wallet's bc1q address.

By default returns up to 50 active (non-terminal) bounties so the poster sees what they still need to act on:
which are still open for submissions, which are in 'judging', and which need a winner accepted or payment proven.

Pass status='paid' / 'cancelled' / 'abandoned' to see specific terminal states. Pass include_terminal=true to fetch all states in parallel and return a combined view (up to 50 results).

No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

btc_address.description: BTC address to query. Omit to use the current wallet's bc1q address.

include_terminal.description: If true, fetches active + paid + cancelled + abandoned in parallel and returns a combined view sorted by createdAt desc (up to 50 results).

name: bounty_my_posted
